description: Scrape Hacker News front page and display top stories

files.content:
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json

print('Scraping Hacker News...')
r = requests.get('https://news.ycombinator.com', timeout=10)
soup = BeautifulSoup(r.text, 'html.parser')

stories = []
for item in soup.select('.titleline > a')[:10]:
    stories.append({'title': item.text, 'url': item.get('href', '')})

print(f'\nTop {len(stories)} Stories:')
print('=' * 60)
for i, s in enumerate(stories, 1):
    print(f"{i:2}. {s['title']}")
    if s['url'].startswith('http'):
        print(f"    {s['url']}")

print(f'\n{json.dumps(stories, indent=2)}')
